rows.purpose: Object: pointer to its actor transform record.
rows.evidence: Live: matched the camera target's actor.

rows.purpose: Object: 16-bit state flags; bit 0 set once activated.
rows.evidence: Live: 0x20A before activation, 0x220B after.

rows.purpose: Object: 20-bit slot index used in handles.
rows.evidence: Live: handle built from it resolved back to the same object.

rows.purpose: Object: 11-bit generation used in handles.
rows.evidence: Live: handle built from it resolved back to the same object.

rows.purpose: Object: pointer to the actor asset it was created from.
rows.evidence: Live: the hero object's field equalled the lookup of the hero actor asset; the puppet's equalled the Miles actor asset.

rows.purpose: Object: component table (descriptor, instance pairs).
rows.evidence: Live: 290 entries enumerated on the hero, 26 on the puppet.

rows.purpose: Object: 16-bit capacity of the component table.
rows.evidence: Live enumeration.

rows.purpose: Component descriptor: pointer to its class name.
rows.evidence: Live: names matched RTTI, for example SkinManager.

rows.purpose: Actor: 4x4 world matrix, translation in the last row.
rows.evidence: Live movement traces.

rows.purpose: Actor: zero while the actor is alive.
rows.evidence: Live traces and the engine's own checks.

rows.purpose: Actor: field the engine passes as the third argument of its own transform write.
rows.evidence: The hero spawn code calls the transform write with actor+0x70; the live mirror used the same call for 1772 frames.

rows.purpose: Actor: pointer to its joint matrices (4x4 floats, actor space).
rows.evidence: Live: copying the hero's array posed the puppet.

rows.purpose: Number of joints in the hero base rig.
rows.evidence: Live: 241 valid matrices, zero matrices after; scale and range measured over 1015 frames.

rows.purpose: SkinManager: pointer to its part array.
rows.evidence: Live: hero had 3 populated parts.

rows.purpose: SkinManager: number of part slots.
rows.evidence: Live: 65 on hero and puppet.

rows.purpose: SkinManager: bytes per part slot.
rows.evidence: Engine indexing constant 0x6B8; live reads lined up.

rows.purpose: Part slot: 64-bit id of its skin config.
rows.evidence: Live: ids read from the hero dressed the puppet.

rows.purpose: SkinManager vtable offset of the add-parts method.
rows.evidence: Live: call added the hero's parts to the puppet.

rows.purpose: Add-parts argument: pointer to its items.
rows.evidence: Engine accessor at 0x27DF940; live call.

rows.purpose: Add-parts argument: item count.
rows.evidence: Engine loop bound; live call.

rows.purpose: Add-parts argument: bytes per item.
rows.evidence: Engine accessor constant 0xC8; live call.

rows.purpose: Add-parts item: 64-bit skin config id.
rows.evidence: Engine read at item+0x34; live call.

rows.purpose: Look: pointer to its body-group entries (16 bytes each).
rows.evidence: norfmare's documented layout; live read gave four entries with the known mask and hood ids.

rows.purpose: Look: number of body-group entries.
rows.evidence: norfmare's documented layout; live read gave 4.
